queriesList.name: Queries per User (15d)

options.description: Number of queries run by each user in the last 15 days, most active first

queriesList.query: select count(*) as count, createdby from queryhistory where createdby != '' and to_timestamp(createdat) > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 DAY' group by createdby order by count desc

queriesList.name: Query history (15d)

options.description: Most recent 500 queries from the last 15 days, newest first

queriesList.query: select to_timestamp(createdat) as created, createdby, namespace, applicationnames, keyword, requesttype, durationsec, timetofirst from queryhistory where to_timestamp(createdat) > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 DAY' order by createdat desc limit 500

queriesList.name: Query count (15d)

options.description: Total number of queries run in the last 15 days
options.label: Queries

queriesList.query: select count(*) as value from queryhistory where to_timestamp(createdat) > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 DAY'

queriesList.name: Query search range (15d)

options.description: How far back users search: Search and AdvanceSearch queries in the last 15 days, bucketed by the length of the time range searched

queriesList.query: select case when durationsec < 3600 then '<1h' when durationsec < 86400 then '1-24h' when durationsec < 604800 then '1-7d' when durationsec < 2592000 then '7-30d' else '>30d' end as searchrange, count(*) as count from queryhistory where requesttype in (2,4) and durationsec > 0 and to_timestamp(createdat) > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 DAY' group by searchrange order by min(durationsec)

queriesList.name: TTFR (Seconds) (15d)

options.description: Distribution of time-to-first-record in seconds over the last 15 days; queries that never returned a record are excluded

queriesList.query: select count(*) as count, timetofirst from queryhistory where timetofirst > 0 and to_timestamp(createdat) > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 DAY' group by timetofirst order by timetofirst

queriesList.name: TTFR by Request Type (15d)

options.description: Time-to-first-record distribution over the last 15 days, split by request type; panel 5 is the same data without the breakdown

queriesList.query: select count(*) as count, timetofirst, case requesttype when 1 then 'Query' when 2 then 'Search' when 3 then 'None' when 4 then 'AdvanceSearch' when 5 then 'Report' when 6 then 'Replay' else 'Unknown' end as request_type from queryhistory where timetofirst > 0 and to_timestamp(createdat) > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 DAY' group by timetofirst, requesttype order by timetofirst
